segments.name: Biopharmaceutical
segments.description: Develops drug candidates, including Lucid-MS for multiple sclerosis and alcohol misuse treatments, for hospitals and medical practices.
segments.evidence: The Company's Biopharmaceutical segment is focused on furthering the research and development of the Company's drug candidates and the development of a treatment for alcohol misuse for application in hospitals and other medical practices.

segments.name: Strategic Investments
segments.description: Earned returns from loans secured by residential property; the loan portfolio was sold in 2025.
segments.evidence: The Company's Strategic Investments segment was focused on generating returns and cash flow through the issuance of loans secured by residential property, with FSD Strategic Investments having a first or second collateral mortgage on the secured property.

revenueModel.text: Unbuzzd and Celly U.S. pay the Company a royalty on their revenue from unbuzzd products under the Unbuzzd IP License Agreement.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company has also licensed unbuzzd™, a proprietary formulation of natural ingredients, vitamins, and minerals to help with liver and brain function for the purposes of quickly relieving individuals from the effects of alcohol consumption, to Unbuzzd and Celly U.S., and is entitled to a royalty on the revenue generated by Unbuzzd and Celly U.S. from sales of products created using the technology rights granted under the Unbuzzd IP License Agreement.

changes.text: The Strategic Investments segment's residential loan portfolio was sold in 2025 and the segment did not continue into the subsequent fiscal year.
changes.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, the Company no longer holds any loans secured by residential properties and has no further rights or obligations with respect to the sold portfolio.
